# 3 bed detached house for sale

> Property Partners Moore Larkin, together with joint selling agent Property Partners Richard Cleary are delighted to offer for sale this superb three bedroom residence. Centrally located on the Old Dublin Road, Cnoc Mhuire is just a ten minute walk from Athlone town centre and also a ten minute walk in the opposite direction to TUS Campus Athlone.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 92.5 m²
- Energetická náročnost: E2
- Lokalita: Cnoc Mhuire, Dublin Road, Athlone
- Cena: 350 000 €
